rootCauseOneLine: resolveRelativeLocalFileHref (apps/app/src/components/ui/markdown-local-file-link.ts L294-L323) rejects absolute/fragment/query/scheme hrefs but has no case for shell home paths, so `~/x` is string-joined onto the workspace root, yielding `<root>/~/x`, which passes every containment check and opens as a workspace file tab whose Open-in-editor fails with path_not_found.
proposedFix: Add `isHomeRelativePath(path)` (regex /^~[^/]*(?:\/|$)/) and include `isHomeRelativePath(parsedHref.path)` in the early-return guard of resolveRelativeLocalFileHref, next to the startsWith("/") check. It runs on the decoded href so `%7E/` is covered too. Verified in worktree: repro test 5/5 green, existing markdown-local-file-link/markdown-preview tests pass, turbo typecheck @bb/app clean, live app shows plain code / plain anchor. Diff saved at /tmp/bb-reports/issues/1182/repro/proposed-fix.diff. Add the tilde cases to markdown-local-file-link.test.ts. Option 2 (expand ~ via host home) would need a new host payload field + HOST_DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION bump and should be a separate change.
caveats: Not fixed on origin/main as of today (git log 16ceb3a54..origin/main on the file is empty). PR #1504 was an agent duplicate, already closed; no open PR to review. Sawyer's comment that percent-encoded `%7E/` needs separate handling is inaccurate for a check placed after safeDecodeURIComponent (the natural spot); only double-encoded `%257E` survives, harmlessly. Bare unformatted `~/x` text is not autolinked; the bug requires inline code ending in .md/.markdown or an explicit markdown link, and only in assistant messages (also markdown file previews and plugin panels via the same resolver). After the fix `[t](~/x)` remains a plain relative anchor (dead in-app route on click) rather than being fully de-linked. First spawn prompt lost its backticks because pnpm's shell did command substitution; second turn via run-cli.js exercised the inline-code form.
